delta: The automated implementation, public-surface, packed-browser, accessibility, performance, and independent-review gates are complete, but the accepted 12-developer formative usability gate has no retained participant evidence.

rootCause: Automated browser acceptance cannot produce independent human discoverability and task-timing evidence.
Diff-isolated review deliberately omits content before its baseline, so generated evidence can refer to a clean commit the packet does not repeat.
correctiveActions: Retain the non-waivable human study as a blocking constraint and keep refinement convergence running.
Record source commit, dirty-scope result, gate version, threshold snapshot, hashes, critic findings, and explicit resolutions in the archive packet.
Do not mark KBD task 12 complete or archive the change until participant evidence satisfies the accepted criterion.
